launcher_changes: scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py: IDTECH3_NO_CUSTOM_MODE = set() - drop ReturnToCastleWolfenstein AND SoldierOfFortune2. Both engines render 1920x1080 through r_mode -1 on hardware (.240 R1/R2/F2 for RTCW, P1 for SoF2.exe, S2 for the patched sof2mp.exe). The .246 measurement behind the set was RTCW's first-run Com_SetRecommended pass (F1), and sof2mp's was r_mode's registered minimum 3.0f, which this patch changes to -1.0f.

stage-fleetres.py: give idtech3_cfg() a fov=True parameter (append the cg_fov line only when wide AND fov), and add an RTCW branch in new_launcher() before the IDTECH3_NO_CUSTOM_MODE one: block = [CALL] + idtech3_cfg(mod, fov=False); args = '+set com_recommendedSet 1 ' + idtech3_args(fov=False). That rewrites 'Play Return to Castle Wolfenstein.bat' and 'Play RTCW Multiplayer.bat' (both 'new' recipes) to write Main\fleetres.cfg = seta r_mode "-1", r_customwidth "%FR_W%", r_customheight "%FR_H%", r_customaspect "1", r_customPixelAspect "1", r_fullscreen "1", r_displayRefresh "%FR_HZ%" and to start 'WolfSP.exe|WolfMP.exe +set com_recommendedSet 1 +set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% +set r_customheight %FR_H% +set r_customaspect 1 +set r_customPixelAspect 1 +set r_fullscreen 1'. The two _REFRESH pairs for those launchers must still read as applied (r_displayRefresh follows r_fullscreen, then a blank line) - re-run --check.

RTCW LAN pair (hand-written on the share, not generated): in 'Host RTCW - LAN.bat' and 'Join RTCW - LAN.bat' replace the three lines '>>"%~dp0Main\fleetres.cfg" echo // r_mode -1 DOES NOT EXIST IN THIS ENGINE - a plain index,' / '... echo // and FR_Q3MODE not FR_Q2MODE: idTech3 mode 8 is 1280x1024.' / '... echo seta r_mode "%FR_Q3MODE%"' with the same seta r_mode "-1" + r_customwidth/height/aspect/PixelAspect lines as above, and on the start line replace '+set r_mode %FR_Q3MODE% +set r_fullscreen 1' with '+set com_recommendedSet 1 +set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% +set r_customheight %FR_H% +set r_customaspect 1 +set r_customPixelAspect 1 +set r_fullscreen 1'. Their 'RESOLUTION: a plain r_mode INDEX' rem blocks are then false - rewrite them. Best done as stage-fleetres 'fix' pairs so --check guards them.

agent/shared/gameres.h: the ReturnToCastleWolfenstein rule 'idtech3-index-nofov' -> a new body 'idtech3-custom-nofov' = the NULL body without its cg_fov line (r_mode -1, r_customwidth %W%, r_customheight %H%, r_customaspect 1, r_customPixelAspect 1, r_fullscreen 1, r_displayRefresh %FRHZ%). gr_w_cfg compares line by line, so it must carry exactly the launcher's setas. Keep 'idtech3-index-nofov' only if another title still uses it.

SoF2 MP ('Play Soldier of Fortune II - Multiplayer.bat', stage-fleetres 'launchers' recipe): idtech3_modecfg('base') -> idtech3_cfg('base') and idtech3_modeargs() -> idtech3_args(), so base\fleetres.cfg gets the standard custom body and the start line '+set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% +set r_customheight %FR_H% +set r_customaspect 1 +set r_customPixelAspect 1 +set r_fullscreen 1 +set cg_fov %FR_FOV%'. ONLY in the same generation as the patched sof2mp.exe (stock clamps -1 to 640x480, S1). Its 'RESOLUTION: r_mode -1 DOES NOT WORK IN THIS ENGINE' rem block becomes false - replace it with a note that the exe carries the 0xBA61A patch.

SoF2 SP (disc-mount launcher): provisioning/discmount/specs/SoldierOfFortune2.json fleetres_block = '\r\n'.join([CALL] + idtech3_cfg('base')) (drops the three 'rem r_customwidth/r_customheight are NOT written' lines and writes r_mode "-1" + the custom size) and vars.GAMEARGS = idtech3_args(); regenerate with make-mount-launcher.py. REMOVE the stage-fleetres 'fix' pairs for SoldierOfFortune2 (Q2MODE->Q3MODE, 'seta r_mode "-1"'->FR_Q3MODE, and the +set -1 -> FR_Q3MODE pair): left in, repair() reverts the SP launcher to the index.

agent/shared/gameres.h: the SoldierOfFortune2 rule 'idtech3-index' -> NULL (the standard custom body, which already carries cg_fov and matches idtech3_cfg('base')). Both launchers and GAMERES then write the SAME base\fleetres.cfg (today the SP and MP launchers write two different bodies). test_gameres_mirror.py and test_fleetres_staging.py must stay green - they may pin RTCW/SoF2 as no-custom-mode titles; update those assertions with the measurement, not the other way round.

SoF2 cg_fov: keep %FR_FOV% (106 on 16:9) - harmless; the MP cgame registers cg_fov 80..100 with LOCK_RANGE (flags 0x2001), so MP plays at 100. RTCW stays without cg_fov (the verified F2 run used none; the default 90 is vert- at 16:9 - a cg_fov test on hardware is a separate, optional step).
Docs after deploy: CLAUDE.md 'What cannot reach 1080p' drops SoF2 and RTCW; provisioning/fleetres/PER-TITLE-STATUS.md rows for both.
deploy_rules: RTCW pk3: publish only in the same generation as the RTCW launcher/gameres move to r_mode -1.
SoF2 pk3 + sof2mp.exe: publish together, and only with the SoF2 launcher/gameres/discmount move to r_mode -1.
